root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ContactTypesTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.ContactTypesTbl', N'DriverCollectionOnly') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.ContactTypesTbl ADD DriverCollectionOnly BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_ContactTypesTbl_DriverCollectionOnly DEFAULT (0); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ContactTypesTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.ContactTypesTbl', N'DriverCollectionOnly') IS NOT NULL BEGIN UPDATE dbo.ContactTypesTbl SET DriverCollectionOnly = 1 WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ContactTypeDesc)) = N'Supplier'; END
